extracted.intended_audience: policymakers, journalists, donors, scholars, Brookings staff, and the interested public
extracted.subtask_description: Institutional standards and commitments governing Brookings' research, publications, events, media engagement, and funding/transparency practices. The page describes mission goals and quality/integrity expectations that guide produced outputs and public-facing activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonpartisan research and policy strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Brookings equips decisionmakers with nonpartisan research and policy strategies to create a more prosperous and secure country and world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work and communications should be framed and produced in a nonpartisan manner, aiming to inform decisionmakers and the public without political bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission goal — develop economic growth strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop economic growth strategies for a changing world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research programs and public outputs addressing economic policy should prioritize actionable strategies responsive to changing global conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission goal — expand economic and social opportunity
rubrics_metrics.description: Expand economic and social opportunity for all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects and communications should consider inclusivity of opportunity and the distributional effects of policy recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission goal — revitalize U.S. democratic institutions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work relating to governance and institutions should focus on strengthening democratic processes and trust in institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission goal — advance peace and security worldwide
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foreign policy and security research should aim at pragmatic recommendations to promote global peace and stability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality, independence, and impact of research
rubrics_metrics.description: At the core of our mission is the quality, independence, and impact of our research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research outputs must demonstrate high quality and independence and be designed to have measurable policy or public impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scholastic rigor and open-minded inquiry
rubrics_metrics.description: We are dedicated to finding bold, pragmatic solutions for societal challenges through open-minded inquiry, diverse perspectives, and holding ourselves to the highest standards of scholastic rigor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Researchers should employ rigorous methods, be open to multiple perspectives, and document evidence and reasoning clearly and transparently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigorous, evidence-based research driven by inclusivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Brookings’ research is rigorous, evidence-based, and driven by a commitment to inclusivity and open-mindedness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research claims should be supported by evidence; design and outreach should intentionally include diverse voices and consider equity implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Events should be thought-provoking and accessible
rubrics_metrics.description: Engage with leaders, experts, and policy-wonks from around the globe in-person or online at our thought-provoking panel discussions, book talks, film screenings, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Events ought to convene relevant experts, foster substantive discussion, and be accessible both in-person and virtually to broaden impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Books should provide in-depth explorations for policymakers and public
rubrics_metrics.description: Books published by Brookings experts provide in-depth explorations of the issues that matter most to policymakers and the public alike.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Long-form publications should offer rigorous, policy-relevant analysis and be written for both specialist and broader audiences where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Podcasts should offer insightful, explanatory perspectives
rubrics_metrics.description: Brookings’ podcasts offer insightful perspectives on important topics, amplifying voices and providing in-depth explanations (e.g., rural Americans, climate change).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Audio work should clarify complex issues, elevate diverse voices, and be produced to inform listeners with depth and clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Testimony should exemplify nonpartisanship and civil discourse
rubrics_metrics.description: Brookings experts testify before Congress and engage with government officials in the U.S. and abroad, always striving to set an example of nonpartisanship and civil discourse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When providing testimony or direct policy advice, maintain impartiality, respect, and a focus on evidence-based recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media engagement and resources for journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: As leaders in their fields, our experts regularly engage with top journalists and media organizations; Brookings is one of the most cited think tanks by news outlets worldwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media interactions should communicate research findings clearly, accurately, and accessibly; Brookings provides resources to facilitate responsible coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence and integrity policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Brookings maintains robust standards and policies to safeguard scholar independence and ensure our research is of the highest quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Staff must follow institutional policies that prevent undue influence on research, disclose conflicts, and preserve editorial independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: We believe that workforce diversity enhances the relevance, substance, and impact of our work and we are committed to championing equity and inclusion across the Institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hiring, programming, research design, and outreach should promote diversity and equitable participation to improve the quality and applicability of outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency in finances and funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Brookings’ annual reports highlight our collective work and impact, embody our commitment to transparency, and give us an opportunity to thank the donors whose financial support makes our work possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial information and funding sources should be publicly available; disclosures should accompany research outputs where relevant to preserve trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility of research and events
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure our research and events remain free and accessible to all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public-facing outputs and events should prioritize accessibility (cost, format, availability) to maximize reach and public benefit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support and stewardship of donor-funded research
rubrics_metrics.description: Your contribution helps strengthen our ability to build a diverse body of research, generate innovative and practical solutions, and ensure our research and events remain free and accessible to all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fundraising should be aligned with institutional commitments to independence, transparency, and accessibility; donor relationships must not compromise research integrity.
